about: Diameter programming on a Sinumerik turning program with no machine chosen: on at the top, assumed from the profile (owner decision D35); off after DIAMOF; DIAM90 reads absolute values as diameters and incremental ones as radii; on again after DIAMON. Also the G26 and LIMS= clamps, and a dwell of either kind, which is neither a feed nor a speed.

states.about: Nothing written yet: the power-on state of the profile, each value assumed; G90 since the owner decision of 2026-10-08 (M10-1).
G710 states millimetres for geometry and feed, so the unit is no longer assumed.
AD-19 rule 4: the S of G26 is the upper speed limit.
LIMS= is a clamp wherever it stands (addresses.speedLimitWords); the S beside it is the cutting speed.
Under DIAM90 an incremental X step is a radius; the mode itself stays what DIAM90 set.
AD-19 rule 6: the F of G4 is the time the tool waits, so the feed in force stays 0.3.
G4 S2 waits two spindle revolutions. That S is not a speed, so the speed in force stays 200.
